tasks.label: Build IPTV Docker image
tasks.command: docker build -t iptv-manager-working-app /Users/david/Desktop/code/iptv-manager-working 2>&1 | tail -6 && echo BUILD_OK

tasks.label: Build IPTV Docker image (no cache)
tasks.command: docker build --no-cache -t iptv-manager-working-app /Users/david/Desktop/code/iptv-manager-working 2>&1 | tail -8 && echo BUILD_OK

tasks.label: Prune and rebuild IPTV image
tasks.command: docker builder prune -f && docker build --no-cache -t iptv-manager-working-app /Users/david/Desktop/code/iptv-manager-working 2>&1 | tail -6 && echo BUILD_OK

tasks.label: Restart container and test /epg.xml
tasks.command: docker compose -f /Users/david/Desktop/code/iptv-manager-working/docker-compose.yml -f /Users/david/Desktop/code/iptv-manager-working/docker-compose-macos.yml up -d --force-recreate && sleep 3 && curl -s http://localhost:5005/epg.xml | head -c 200 && echo

tasks.label: Check EPG logs
tasks.command: docker exec iptv-manager-working-app-1 ls /app/m3u_files/ && docker logs iptv-manager-working-app-1 2>&1 | grep -E 'EPG|epg|found.*channel|filtered' | tail -15
